notes.title: v1.18 "Endorsement Reinforcements" Update Now Available
notes.notes:
v1.18 "Endorsement Reinforcements" UpdateAdding new Endorsements and Issue


The Political Machine 2024 is a political simulation game that allows players to run their own presidential campaigns, navigate complex political landscapes, and engage with various issues and endorsements. The latest update, version 1.18, titled "Endorsement Reinforcements," introduces a few new features aimed at enhancing the gameplay experience without making sweeping changes to the overall mechanics.
New Endorsements[p align="start"]One of the highlights of this update is the addition of three new endorsements that impact a player's campaign strategy:
[olist]
Tech Billionaire: This endorsement provides a substantial boost of 2 million Funds, which can be critical for funding campaign activities. Additionally, it increases Enthusiasm in all states by 10%. This endorsement reflects the growing influence of technology leaders in modern politics and offers players a strategic advantage in resource allocation.

Former President: Securing the endorsement of a former president can lend considerable credibility to a campaign. This endorsement also raises Enthusiasm in all states by 10% and boosts the Issue Score in all states by 20%. This makes it a valuable asset for candidates looking to solidify their standing on key issues.

World's #1 Podcaster: With the rise of social media and digital platforms, the endorsement of the world's #1 podcaster can have a significant impact. This endorsement increases Enthusiasm in all states by 20%, making it a powerful tool for engaging younger voters and those active on social media.
[/olist]New Issue Added[p align="start"]In addition to the new endorsements, the update introduces a new issue relevant to the current political climate: "Release the Epstein Files." This issue has been added to the top 15 issues in the states of Alaska, Massachusetts, Iowa, and North Carolina. This addition reflects ongoing discussions in real-world politics and offers players a chance to navigate the complexities of public sentiment surrounding sensitive topics. While currently relevant, it was important to keep the relevance of this topic to the context of the 2024 Presidential Election to preserve game balance.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]The "Endorsement Reinforcements" update for The Political Machine 2024 may be small, but it provides players with new strategic options to explore as they campaign for the presidency. With the introduction of impactful endorsements and a timely issue, players can further tailor their approach to resonate with voters in this engaging political simulation. As always, the effectiveness of these new features will depend on how players choose to integrate them into their overall campaign strategies.

notes.title: v1.17 'Tariff Update' Now Available
notes.notes:
New Tariff Event Highlights The Political Machine 2024 v1.17 Update
View the full changelog here

We’re excited to share the latest update for The Political Machine 2024, featuring a new breaking news event that adds depth to your gameplay: the “Tariff Proposal Leaked.” This event reflects ongoing discussions around tariff policies, a topic that has been particularly relevant in recent years, especially during President Trump's administration. With this update, the significance of the Tariffs issue will be moderately elevated across all states, prompting players to consider this critical topic as they strategize their campaigns.

In addition to the new event, we've made essential updates to state demographics and party registration data. These updates incorporate the latest findings from the 2024 election exit polls and results, ensuring that the game accurately reflects the current political climate. By aligning the game data with real-world statistics, we aim to provide a more immersive experience for players as they navigate their political journeys.

We are committed to continuously updating The Political Machine 2024 to reflect real-time political shifts and developments. This dedication ensures that players remain engaged and informed while crafting their campaign strategies. Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new features included in this update!

notes.title: Pre-Election Update Released
notes.notes:
Final major update to political strategy simulation updates issues and voter enthusiasm to give most accurate model yet 

Stardock Entertainment released the final major update for its political strategy/simulation game, The Political Machine 2024 today.  The new version adjusts the top political issues along with voter enthusiasm as of October 2024. 

“We are seeing a lot of movement on voter enthusiasm,” said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock Entertainment.  “The election is solidifying around a handful of key issues such as inflation, abortion and the border.” 

For the enthusiasm update, Stardock has attempted to simulate the effect early voting is having on turn-out and how it might affect the election. 

“It’s been challenging to have the game’s underlying model factor in voting that occurs over multiple days,” said Wardell. “But I think we are getting there.  We will see how close we are soon enough.” 

As for the game’s much-celebrated deep-election simulation features, where AI Donald Trump runs against AI Kamala Harris in pure sim mode, the outcome remains too close to call but with a slight edge for Trump. 

“The model continues to call out North Carolina as a state we should be keeping an eye on.  We are still investigating why it thinks North Carolina and not Pennsylvania is the linchpin state,” said Wardell. 

View the full changelog here.

notes.title: v1.12 Update: Adds J.D. Vance, Recent Real-World Issues, More Customization
notes.notes:
J.D. Vance, real-world issues, new custom candidate body parts, and improved gameplay experiences

The Political Machine 2024 continues to evolve with this update, bringing several new updates that include the addition of J. D. Vance as Donald Trump’s running mate, the introduction of timely real-world issues such as Trump’s Assassination Attempt, and expanded customization options for creating unique candidates. This update also includes various gameplay improvements to ensure a smoother and more engaging political simulation experience.

View the Full Changelog

New Candidate: J. D. Vance Joins the Race
In a move that mirrors recent real-world political developments, J. D. Vance, Donald Trump’s newly nominated running mate, has been added to the game. This addition allows players to explore new strategies and dynamics as they navigate the complex world of American politics.

Addressing Real-World Issues
One of the standout features of this update is the inclusion of new issues that reflect current events and debates. Players can now tackle topics such as Trump’s Assassination Attempt, Biden’s Debate Performance, Addressing Political Extremism, Israel-Palestine Peace, and the Foreign Social Media Ban. These additions ensure that The Political Machine 2024 remains relevant and thought-provoking, offering players a chance to engage with the pressing issues of our time.

New Body Parts for Custom Candidate Creation
For those who love to personalize their candidates, the update brings a variety of new custom candidate body parts. From bowties and various head shapes to an array of noses, hairstyles, and facial expressions, the customization options are more extensive than ever. Whether you want your candidate to sport a scholarly combed side hairdo or a distinctive egg-shaped head, the possibilities are now broader.

Enhanced Gameplay Experience
The update isn't just about new faces. A series of bug fixes and improvements have been implemented to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience. AI adjustments, AI vs AI speedup, balance changes, and quality of life enhancements are all part of this update, making your political campaigns more engaging and realistic.


The Political Machine 2024 v1.12 update is a testament to the game's commitment to staying current and engaging. With the addition of J. D. Vance, timely new issues, and a host of gameplay improvements, players can look forward to an enriched political simulation experience. As real-world events continue to unfold, The Political Machine 2024 remains a compelling platform for exploring the intricacies of American politics.

notes.title: Now Available: v1.1 Command & Conquer Update
notes.notes:
v1.1 Command & Conquer Update introduces the War Room & Enhanced Endorsement System 

Today, Stardock Entertainment released the v1.1 Command & Conquer Update for its political strategy game, The Political Machine 2024. This update includes the introduction of the War Room, a revamped Endorsement System, and several quality-of-life improvements aimed at enhancing the player experience.

The v1.1 Command & Conquer update introduces two major features designed to deepen the strategic gameplay for both new and existing players. The War Room allows candidates to spend campaign funds to purchase Operative Cards from a market. These cards, which can be played at any time without additional costs, offer various tactical advantages to influence the campaign's outcome.

Additionally, the Endorsement System has been overhauled. Candidates can now spend Political Capital to secure endorsements from 12 unique groups, each providing immediate benefits. This new approach removes the randomness of previous systems, allowing for more deliberate and strategic endorsement acquisition. Together, these features add a new layer of strategy, enabling players to dynamically adjust their campaign tactics.

"With the Command & Conquer update, we wanted to give players more control over their campaign strategies," said Brad Wardell, CEO of Stardock Entertainment. "The War Room and the enhanced Endorsement System provide new ways to influence the game, making each playthrough more unique and engaging."

For more information on the v1.1 Command & Conquer update, view the full changelog here.

notes.title: NOW OUT: The Presidential Pioneers v1.01 Update for The Political Machine 2024
notes.notes:
The Presidential Pioneers v1.01 Update brings New Candidates, Mac Support, and Game Quality Improvements

Today we released a significant update for their strategy game, The Political Machine 2024. This update introduces an array of past presidential candidates, extends compatibility to macOS, and implements various bug fixes and balance adjustments.

View the full changelog here

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512090/The_Political_Machine_2024/

New Faces in the Political Arena
The latest update enriches the game's roster with notable figures from American political history:

Democrats: Players can now lead campaigns for Democrats like Bill Clinton, Barack Obama, John Kerry, Jimmy Carter, Al Gore, or Martin O’Malley, each offering unique strategic opportunities.

Independents: The game broadens its appeal with independents such as Ross Perot, Ralph Nader, and Jill Stein, providing alternative strategies for reaching the White House.

Republicans: The Republican lineup is enhanced with Ronald Reagan, Mitt Romney, George W. Bush, George Bush Sr., Dwight D. Eisenhower, and Richard Nixon, adding depth and variety to the gameplay.

Mac Version Launch
With this update, The Political Machine 2024 is now available on macOS, allowing Mac users to engage in the electoral challenge. This update aims to bring the game to a wider audience, ensuring that Mac users can enjoy the same detailed and immersive gameplay experience as PC users.

Bug Fixes and Balance Changes
The update addresses several bugs and makes balance changes to improve gameplay fluidity and fairness. These adjustments were made in response to community feedback and are designed to enhance player experience by providing a more stable and equitable game environment.


This update significantly enhances The Political Machine 2024 by broadening the playable character pool and extending platform availability to Mac users. The inclusion of a diverse range of historical political figures allows players to explore various campaign strategies and adds educational value by highlighting key personalities and their political ideologies.

notes.title: Release Day Livestream
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce our release day livestream event for our latest political strategy game, The Political Machine 2024. Get a look at the game's exciting features, including the much-anticipated primaries, debates, and political action cards. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to the political arena, this livestream is the perfect opportunity to see what awaits you in the race for the White House.

When Is It?
May 2, 2024, at 1PM ET. 

What to Expect?
Our team will walk you through the game, showcasing the new features and improvements we've made based on your feedback. You'll get an insider's look at how to run a successful campaign, from winning the primaries to dominating the presidential debates.

Where?
Right here on our Steam page.

We can't wait to share The Political Machine 2024 with you and hear what you think. So, set a reminder, prepare your questions, and join us for an unforgettable journey into the heart of American politics. See you there!

notes.title: Steam Playtest Coming Soon and Release Date Info
notes.notes:
An update on the game release date and announcing the playtest

The game was originally slated to release later this month Feb 2024, however after much deliberation we have made the decision to delay the game to late Spring 2024. This decision was not made lightly.

Due to changing dates in the political landscape, we felt our release best aligns with the late Spring date. Beyond that, the general scope of the original project has increased for the better, with a visual overhaul, new features and more. However, to ensure the best possible experience we wanted time to fine tune these new features, while also collecting proper community feedback.

So with that, we're here to announce that The Political Machine 2024 is gearing up to enter its Steam Playtest Phase soon! This will be a chance for pre-purchasers to dive into the heart of political strategy, make their mark, and help us shape the game into the ultimate political battleground.

Your insights and feedback are invaluable. Help us fine-tune the gameplay, mechanics, and features to ensure the best possible experience for all players.


Stay tuned for more details, thank you for your support!
